Recommendation: authorize no additional spend, monetization expansion, or public launch this cycle; keep the private-preview property private pending owner decision and finance-grade measurement. Supported revenue is only $4.92 Amazon commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21. Aggregate commission per click is approximately $0.00079, but site attribution is incomplete: 629 clicks and all 28 ordered items are under tracking_id “other,” while named site IDs show zero orders and zero commission. Revenue claims are therefore not site-supported. Analytics is unavailable for all 60 registry sites, with 0 configured sites and no traffic, conversion, CAC, or payback data. AI usage cost is $733.04 across 4,340 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-22, including 136 errors; it is an observed cost, not evidence of return, and cannot be compared to one day of revenue for ROI. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, total operating spend, infrastructure spend, CAC, payback, and forecasts are not calculable because site-level revenue attribution, traffic/exposure denominators, direct infrastructure and domain costs, and experiment cost/outcome records are missing. Minimum measurement: reconcile every affiliate click/order/shipment/commission to a site and content identifier, restore site traffic and conversion telemetry, capture infrastructure/domain and other direct operating costs by site, and record experiment exposure, incremental outcome, and AI cost by run. Until then, treat clicks, ordered items, social coverage, SEO scores, and AI call volume as non-financial vanity or activity metrics; continue only already-approved measurement gates and make no duplicate queue or spend action.
